summary: Learn Microsoft Project scheduling, indicator tracking and project evaluation methods. Build practical controls and reporting skills. Enquire today.
lede: Microsoft Project scheduling training covers building a work breakdown structure, linking tasks and setting milestones and baselines. For project managers, project officers and monitoring and evaluation specialists, it supports delivery planning and results reporting. Participants practise indicator tracking, reviewing schedule and cost variances with earned value measures, and creating an Excel dashboard from project status data.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already contribute to projects and need to connect schedules, budgets, monitoring evidence and evaluation findings. It is designed for roles that plan delivery, maintain project controls or report results to internal and external stakeholders.
modules: Theory of Change and Project Results
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of project activities, basic scheduling and routine progress reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. For the Microsoft Project exercises, access to a compatible Microsoft Project application is recommended; Excel access supports dashboard and indicator exercises.
